data.summary: Simple View is a minimal interface within the Qursor system that displays lock zones and station groups for quick monitoring. It presents the names, current states, and assigned tasks of stations within configured groups to facilitate easy reference.

own_body.title: Simple View
own_body.summary: Simple View provides a clear and minimal display of lock zones and station groups, which can be active and visible simultaneously after configuration in the Qursor system.

children.title: There are two main views available:
children.summary: The section lists two main views: Configuration Groups and Lock Zones.

children.title: The interface shows:
children.summary: The interface displays the names of stations in a group, their current state, and assigned tasks. It is designed for quick reference and easy monitoring, specifically when lock zones and groups are configured.
